key_block_probes.what: the first bucket export was exact at t512 / t1024 / t2048 and wrong (and different on every call) at t4096; the probes below isolate it to the plain softmax(q k^T * s [+ bias]) v chain at 4,032 keys or more on this GPU stack, each op alone exact, and keys in blocks of <= 2,048 with one shared max exact (the variant 'split2'); clef_head.py uses that form above 2,048 keys (KEY_CHUNK)

decoder_readout.gate: decoder alone on the Mac GPU (oracle ids, oracle fp32 image_embeds -> fp16, zero-padded to 1024 rows), the fp16 hidden read through the author's fp32 head
decoder_readout.readout: fresh zero states; a row of T ids runs as ceil(T / 64) calls of 'main' (static S = 64): call k gets ids[64k : 64k + 64] with position_ids 0..64k+63; the last call is padded with <|endoftext|> (248044) and the hidden rows of the padded positions are discarded (causal: they cannot reach a real position). The hidden rows [1, 64, 4096] of every call, concatenated and cut to T, are the backbone's final-norm last_hidden_state [T, 4096] the head reads.
